title: Trimble for Government Achieves 'Initial Implementation' Status for FedRAMP Class C (Moderate) Certification
summary: Milestone accelerates secure cloud adoption for federal, state and local entities managing infrastructure, spatial data and capital assets WESTMINSTER, Colo., Oct. 20, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Trimble...
body_markdown:
*Milestone accelerates secure cloud adoption for federal, state and local entities managing infrastructure, spatial data and capital assets*


WESTMINSTER, Colo.


, Oct. 20, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Trimble today announced that[Trimble for Government](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4801649-1&h=3433616469&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.trimble.com%2Fen%2Findustries%2Fgovernment&a=Trimble+for+Government) is listed as 'Initial Implementation' status for Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP®) Class C (Moderate) certification and is now listed on the[FedRAMP Marketplace](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4801649-1&h=3748869704&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.fedramp.gov%2Fmarketplace%2Fproducts%2FFR2701247929%2F&a=FedRAMP+Marketplace) . In conjunction with seeking FedRAMP certification, Trimble is also pursuing GovRAMP authorization to support state, local and education (SLED) customers with reciprocal cybersecurity compliance standards.


This dual milestone marks a critical step forward in delivering a software as a service (SaaS) cloud environment built within a secure Government Community Cloud. Designed specifically for U.S. Federal Government departments, state and local agencies, and defense and civilian contractors, Trimble for Government provides a unified ecosystem for managing infrastructure, spatial data, capital projects, permitting and facility assets across their entire lifecycle.


Achieving FedRAMP Class C (Moderate) and GovRAMP alignment will enable public sector entities and Department of Defense (DoD) contractors to comply with stringent security mandates — including Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) alignment — while modernizing digital engineering and asset management.


"Federal, state and local agencies face the dual challenge of modernizing critical infrastructure while maintaining uncompromising cybersecurity standards," said Mark Schwartz, group president, AECO at Trimble. "Achieving 'Initial Assessment' status reflects our commitment to delivering mission-critical spatial, capital project and asset management capabilities inside a secure, audit-ready cloud boundary across all levels of government."


Integrated cloud solutions built for government operations


The in-scope environment brings together Trimble's proven field execution, asset, project and permitting software into four modular packages designed to support specific public sector outcomes:


- **Trimble** ® **Field Collaboration:** Delivers field data services using foundational spatial database infrastructure and GIS integration to support high-security field operations, map assets, and enable seamless field-to-cloud workflows across Trimble's core Field Systems portfolio.
- **Trimble Project Management** powered by Trimble ProjectSight® software: Connects design-to-build workflows in the field, providing precision data layout, project tracking, collaboration and quality assurance across construction projects.
- **Trimble Asset Management** powered by Trimble Unity™ Maintain software **:** Serves as a centralized facilities data core for federal, state, and local government agencies, military installations, and public infrastructure — such as public buildings, utilities, and transportation networks — to optimize maintenance and long-term capital planning.
- **Trimble Permit Management** powered by Trimble Unity Permit software **:** Streamlines end-to-end management of permitting, licensing, land use and infrastructure rights-of-way in a fully compliant cloud environment.


The unifying in-scope element across all four packages is the Trimble Connect® platform, providing collaboration and a common data environment (CDE) across the Trimble for Government platform.


With assessment processes underway, Trimble continues to advance toward full FedRAMP and GovRAMP authorizations to ensure public sector customers can innovate with confidence.


**About Trimble** Trimble is a global technology company that connects the physical and digital worlds, transforming the ways work gets done. With relentless innovation in precise positioning, modeling and data analytics, Trimble enables essential industries including construction, geospatial and transportation. Whether it's helping customers build and maintain infrastructure, design and construct buildings, optimize global supply chains or map the world, Trimble is at the forefront, driving productivity and progress.
